job_description.title: Senior Project Manager
job_description.jd_text: We are seeking a Senior Project Manager with 8 to 12 years of experience delivering software projects across distributed teams. The candidate must have strong Project Management skills for end-to-end delivery ownership, Scrum Management expertise for agile sprint planning and retrospectives, Stakeholder Management for client communication and expectation alignment, Team Management for leading cross-functional engineering teams, and Negotiation Skill for scope and contract discussions. Location: Pune with WFH or Hybrid arrangement.

job_description.title: Technical Program Manager
job_description.jd_text: We are looking for a Technical Program Manager with 8 to 12 years of experience bridging delivery management and engineering leadership. The candidate must have Project Management skills for multi-team delivery coordination, Scrum Management for agile ceremonies at programme level, Kubernetes for understanding container workload management and capacity planning, Jenkins for governing CI/CD pipelines and release automation, and Terraform for infrastructure-as-code oversight and cloud cost governance. Preferred skills include Stakeholder Management for executive reporting, Microservices architecture knowledge for technical roadmap discussions, AWS cloud services for infrastructure planning, Architecture Review experience for design approvals, and Team Management for engineering leads. Location: Pune, Hybrid work model.
